items.title: Fed officials expect more rate hikes, worry about AI impact on inflation, minutes show
items.summary: Federal Reserve officials expressed confidence in October that further interest rate increases will be needed to stem inflation, though they decided to hold off while gathering more information, according to meeting minutes released Wednesday.

items.title: I watched Trump, Xi and Putin gather in China. Here are my top takeaways
items.summary: SHENZHEN, China — It took a trip to China for me, an American, to see U.S. President Donald Trump in person for the first time.

items.title: Tech outages are causing people to panic-buy. Costco is benefiting, Mizuho says
items.summary: A series of tech outages has consumers stocking up on emergency supplies. Costco sales are seeing a lift because of it, according to research firm Mizuho.

items.title: Fed’s Waller says central bank may need to ‘shock people’ with half-point rate hike
items.summary: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller on Wednesday called for aggressive action against inflation , saying the central bank needs to "shock people" as prices continue to rise more than he expected.

items.title: Putin says EU is losing industry, falling behind competition, ahead of meeting with Trump and Xi
items.summary: SHENZHEN, China — Russian President Vladimir Putin said the European Union was falling behind competition in a speech Wednesday at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation CEO Summit.

items.title: Three things to watch as Trump, Xi and Putin meet in China
items.summary: SHENZHEN, China — Leaders of the U.S., China, Russia and other major Asia-Pacific economies face a series of critical issues from wars to tech security as they gather for an annual summit this week.

items.title: JPMorgan is working on AI agent transactions that don’t involve humans
items.summary: Artificial intelligence agents have already proven to be helpful, or cause a lot of trouble, or both.

items.title: Southeast Asia’s data center boom leaned on Chinese demand. New U.S. rules put that pipeline at risk
items.summary: New U.S. export rules could slow Southeast Asia's data center boom by tightening access to advanced AI chips and targeting the region's role in providing computing power to Chinese companies.

items.title: Record diesel prices drive UK inflation to 1-year high of 3.6%
items.summary: U.K. inflation rose to 3.6% in the 12 months to October, its highest level in a year, as fuel costs continued to rise.
